dedupe_keys.name: improved particle acceleration and transport in the heliosphere

description: iPATH models energetic-particle acceleration at coronal-mass-ejection shocks and subsequent transport through the inner heliosphere. It combines a two-dimensional MHD calculation with a particle-transport module. The resource is documented by University of Alabama Huntsville; UAH. The documented physical domain is Solar, Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA layout), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Predictive usefulness depends on obtaining suitable eruption parameters early enough. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
